svg.title: Jacketed continuous stirred-tank reactor
svg.desc: Exploded isometric cutaway of a jacketed stirred tank. A finned electric motor, gearbox and coupling drive a shaft and four-blade impeller. Two wall baffles interrupt swirl. A sparse dither band shades the liquid; hatched sections distinguish the pressure wall from the cooling jacket. A flanged feed enters the raised lid, two side nozzles serve the jacket, and a separate lower nozzle withdraws product. Closed, the lid and drive seat on the vessel flange and the intact jacket covers the cut.
